summary: mlflow typosquat exfiltrates host recon and executes remote stage-2 payload at install and import
details: Package impersonates the legitimate mlflow project (author metadata and homepage point at github.com/mlflow/mlflow) but ships only a recon/RCE payload. setup.py exec-compiles payload_core.py at install time, and mlflow_ui/__init__.py runs the same payload at import time. The payload collects hostname, platform, the full os.environ, /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf, /proc/self/cgroup, /proc/1/cmdline, directory listings of /, /app, /opt, /srv, /home, /tmp, `ps aux` and `ip addr` output, and internal-service port probe results, base64-encodes them, and POSTs them to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint. A second stage fetches https://webhook.site/.../s2.py over a TLS context with certificate verification disabled and passes the response body to exec/compile with subprocess/os/send helpers injected into globals, yielding arbitrary remote code execution on the installer's host at both install and import time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
